map.「基于WHO肺炎管理标准，根据呼吸频率、临床体征评估肺炎严重程度并给出处置建议」: The pneumonia severity assessor, based on WHO pneumonia-management standard, assesses severity by respiratory rate and clinical signs and gives management advice, outputting results from the input parameters.
map.提示：呼吸增快是诊断肺炎最敏感的体征。胸凹陷(下胸壁内陷)提示重症。低氧血症(S: Note: tachypnea is the most sensitive sign of pneumonia. Chest indrawing (lower chest wall retraction) suggests severe disease. Hypoxemia (SpO2<90%) needs oxygen. Neonatal pneumonia is atypical (bubbling/periodic breathing). Severe pneumonia needs complication workup (empyema/pneumothorax/ARDS). This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.2 月儿 RR≥60 为促、本例 50 超标且 SpO₂ 88<90→重症肺炎，: 2-mo infant RR≥60 is tachypnea; this case 50 exceeds and SpO2 88<90 -> severe pneumonia, admit for oxygen.
map.无气促、SpO₂≥95、进食可→社区口服抗生素随访。: No tachypnea, SpO2≥95, feeding OK -> community oral antibiotics follow-up.
map.<2 月≥60、2–12 月≥50、1–5 岁≥40 次/分为呼吸急促。: <2 mo ≥60, 2-12 mo ≥50, 1-5 yr ≥40 breaths/min is tachypnea.
map.SpO₂<90、胸陷、拒食、发绀、嗜睡任一项即重症。: SpO2<90, chest indrawing, feeding refusal, cyanosis, lethargy - any one means severe.
map.儿童肺炎(呼吸急促/凹陷)严重度评估器，基于WHO标准评估肺炎严重程度及住院指征: The pediatric pneumonia (tachypnea/indrawing) severity assessor, based on WHO standard, assesses severity and admission indications. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
